purpose: thumbfix3: Nord2Metal back to y2s76-thumbfix2 (YCbCr thumbnails converted on the GPU, odd sizes fixed, Photos' converted textures kept against pool reuse) WITHOUT the thumbcomp diagnostics. The black grid was not the driver: backboardd detaches Photos' opaque drawable to its own SwapEnd layer and SweetFramebuffer memcpy'd the transparent UI layer over it; fixed by kernel patch 0390 (image q10jfb). Install together with q10jfb.
